title: KRUEL ALPHA AND DEMO
author: No_Background9234
selftext:
I don’t know wether to tag this as self promo or demo/ project/ workflow so I did promotion just off the link I posted.  

I recently released my game on itch with a free demo and would love to get more feedback on it. I used Claude to help me make the LAB tool with which I am using to adjust code and build most of the game world with while all assets are handmade and some are just placeholders right now as the real ones get swapped in for those. 

Link: https://anotherdayinparadise.itch.io/kruel

We have 2 different trailers showcasing the gameplay and then the custom map maker. 


Edit: the builder showcase trailer shows the Lab tool in use.
